writeSurface._what: The WRITE surface omega authors against, separate from the 61.2.0 metric/transform/vocabulary extraction above (which this note does not refresh). Since contract 85.0.0 a strategy changes only through its draft: get_strategy_draft -> stage_strategy_draft -> commit_strategy_draft. Since 108.0.0 the stage takes eight axes: SIGNAL_RULES and SETUP_GATES are refused as unrecognized keys and minAtrPct is required on TRADE_LEVEL_POLICY (README 'Contract history - v108', vendored at .agents/skills/battlegrid/README.md, pack 31.2.94). Since 110.0.0 (README 'Contract history - v110') the metric keys MACD, PPO and KC_MID are refused (MACD_HIST, PPO_HIST, EMA20) and nine keys are added; the schema moved to the 110.2.0 capture on 2026-10-14. Since 110.6 (README 'Contract history - v110.6') DONCHIAN_UPPER_PRIOR and DONCHIAN_LOWER_PRIOR are added, and by 110.8.0 NAKED_SINGLE_PRINT_ABOVE/BELOW and TPO_SINGLE_PRINT_ABOVE/BELOW (undocumented); nothing refused; the schema moved to the 110.8.0 capture on 2026-10-15. Since v111 (served as 110.13.0, 2026-10-16; README 'Contract history - v111') the draft tools take their arguments at the top level: no `request` envelope (omega.preflight.resolve_request and omega.condition_vocabulary read both shapes); the schema moved to the 110.13.0 capture on 2026-10-16. Since v134 (README 'Contract history - v134') includeMtfConfluence is refused wherever a platform section is named; its lower-rung reads are custom columns (MA_ALIGN x value, RSI14 x classifyZone, ADX x classifyZone at {rel:'lower'}); PERP_SPOT_GAP is added. Since v135 an efficiency window counts bar-to-bar changes (reads window + 1 bars), six transforms are added (zscore, stddev, linregSlope, pctl, rollingMin, rollingMax) and columnLookback is 64. Since v135.1 thirty-five metrics are added (the bar clock, trading-session levels and swept flags, opening ranges, IB extensions). The schema moved to the 135.2.0 capture on 2026-10-26 (135.2.0 is undocumented in the README; the manager's watch acknowledged it 2026-10-26T06:27Z). Since v137 (README 'Contract history - v137') STOCH_RSI14 is refused (STOCH_RSI_K / STOCH_RSI_D); since v138 BB_WIDTH is refused (BB_WIDTH_PCT) and CUM_VOLUME_DELTA is added; v136.1 added six spot metrics, v137.2 sixty-six (the anchored VWAP family with bands, week and month profiles) and respelled every metric enum as $defs/metricKey, v137.3 three; v139 removed BUY_PRES_BYB and v140 SPOT_CLOSE_BYB; v142.3 added the relativeTo transform, the `instrument` column knob and the priceRatio unit; v143 is Radar-only.
